links.outcome: Local ambient scribe pilot assessing adoption, feasibility, acceptability, appropriateness among oncology providers
links.effect: Providers used the scribe in 620 (13.9%) of 4,449 visits; 17 of 18 survey respondents (94%) used AI-drafted content at least sometimes; 11 (61%) desired continued access.
links.quote: Out of 18 survey respondents, 17 (94%) indicated they used the AI-drafted content at least sometimes, demonstrating feasibility.

screen.reason: Prospective pilot study assessing the real-world adoption, feasibility, acceptability, and appropriateness of an ambient AI scribe tool among oncology providers across outpatient visits.
